name: Morty
text:
Lauren Tan’s Grok Bot setup looks like a real team.

the workflow is simple:

goal → delegate → specialists work → merge results → final answer

instead of asking one agent to do everything, she splits the work across specialists:

→ Chief of Staff plans + delegates
→ Researcher finds and compares information
→ Engineer builds and tests
→ Reviewer checks quality and edge cases
→ Doc Writer turns work into reusable knowledge
→ Operator keeps workflows running
→ Memory Manager preserves context across sessions

that’s how Grok Bot starts feeling less like one assistant - and more like a small AI company working for you.

full playbook below ↓
gist: 介绍 Lauren Tan 的 Grok Bot 多 agent 分工：目标 → 委派 → 专家并行 → 合并 → 答案，角色包括 Chief of Staff、Researcher、Engineer、Reviewer、Doc Writer、Operator、Memory Manager，像一个小型 AI 公司。
